title: Weekly Wrap 845: Productivity despite the bin chickens – Stilgherrian
text:
Stilgherrian

Word-whore. I write 'em. I talk 'em. Information, politics, media, and the cybers. I drink. I use bad words. All publication is a political act. All communication is propaganda. All art is pornography. All business is personal. All hail Eris! Vive les poissons rouges sauvages!

My week of Monday 3 to Sunday 9 August 2026 was another productive one, but once again I can’t show you much of it yet. However I’ve noticed how I’m now becoming more interested in the humble bin chicken since I’ve been living near a colony of the. Yes, the Australian white ibis is much more common in Sydney these days, and they intrigue me.

It’s also another week when I haven’t been pushing the new-season crowdfunder. The 9pm Spring Series 2026, but at the time of writing we’re now 37% of the way to the first target thanks to some extreme generosity. I’ll start organising guests for the new season this week.

None of these this week. I’ve pulled back the podcast production while I’m “between seasons” I’ll consider my options for photos and videos soon. Yes, I’ve said that before. You can subscribe to my YouTube channel to be notified when new videos appear and when the occasional livestreams are scheduled.

On Tuesday I’m having my six-month checkup in the medical trial I’m taking part in, the one for a new trivalent vaccine for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), human metapneumovirus (hMPV), and human parainfluenza virus type 3 (HPV-3). Given that I came down wth RSV in May, I’m guessing that whatever I was injected with didn’t contain the RSV vaccine component.

Other than that, it’s a week like the last few: I haven’t scheduled things for specific days yet, but it will be a mix of client work, administrivia, and podcast planning, and then The Weekly Cybers newsletter will appear on Friday afternoon as usual.

Update 13 August 2026: NEW: I’m sneaking in an episode of The 9pm Edict with Scottish author and social researcher David F Porteous because Clacton by-election and other fun. If you’re a supporter with TRIGGER WORDS or a CONVERSATION TOPIC for this ep, please let me know by 3pm AEST this Friday 14 August.

[Photo: An Australian white ibis (Threskiornis molucca) makes his presence felt in Burwood, Sydney, honking as evening approaches on 4 August 2026.]
